Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2827; not leaning, i.e. (figuratively) firm:--without wavering.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in one of the great exhortations of Hebrews: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; for he is faithful that promised. The word is firm, not leaning, not bending — a confession held straight and steady.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse about holding fast without wavering carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the reason given, not our grip but His faithfulness, because He promised.
